title: MathLoop Studio — Turn Maths Into Movies
These creatures
start with circles.
narration: What if a handful of circles could become a living creature?
And that creature could become your next video?

title: 15 films.
Ready to make
your own.
narration: Meet Math Loop Studio: a creative coding studio for mathematical films.
Start with fifteen authored films, from butterflies and koi to whales and three dimensional sculptures.

title: Your edit.
Your timing.
Your film.
narration: Open Story Studio. Change the titles, captions, and chapter lengths.
Scrub the timeline, preview the animation, and save an editable project.

title: One timeline.
Every frame.
narration: Under the hood, JavaScript turns Fourier curves into animated artwork.
Each frame is a function of time, so preview and export share the same animation model.

title: An SVG goes in.
A story comes out.
scenes.detail: Sample the path → Fourier transform → animate
narration: Import your own SVG outline and watch rotating circles reconstruct it.
The geometry stays local, and travels inside your saved project.

title: Eight scores.
Built from code.
scenes.detail: Synthesized music shaped around your chapters
narration: Choose from eight original synthesized scores, including Whale Song.
The music follows your chapters, so the soundtrack fits your edit.

title: Think outside
the frame.
narration: Then step inside three sixty Studio. Arrange sculptures around a viewpoint and look in any direction.
Export a full spherical movie, or a guided portrait tour for the Shorts feed.

title: From equations
to environments.
narration: Nature Worlds adds photographic landscapes, weather, and directional ambience.
Explore a rainforest, the ocean, or four seasons wrapped around you.

title: Clone it.
Remix it.
Render it.
narration: Render video with sound from the browser, or batch films with the command line tools.
Get Math Loop Studio on GitHub. Star the repository, try a film, and make the next one yours.
